name: s02-karon
text: Pluto and Karon travel around a meeting point in the space between them. That shared dance is something we can see.

name: s01-karon
text: Far beyond Neptune, icy Pluto and its giant moon Karon travel around a shared meeting point. New Horizons flew past in twenty fifteen and saw a bright heart of nitrogen ice. Pluto is still a real world — one of five official dwarf planets.

name: s07-karon
text: Karon. Pluto's giant companion, about half as wide.

name: s13-karon
text: Karon is about half as wide as Pluto — the largest moon compared with its world.

name: s16-karon
text: Pluto has five known moons: Karon, and four much smaller ones named Styx, Nix, Kerberos, and Hydra.
